headline: Judge SLAPS ICE 👮‍♂️💥 for Bunny-Hat Toddler CUFFS 😭🐰🕷️
text:

Straight fire 🔥📢: 'CRUELTY knows NO BOUNDS 🤬💔, even for SPIDEY FANS 🕷️🕸️!' Called for ORDERLY HUMAN POLICY ✊❤️ over this QUOTA ORGY 💦📈 of KID-CUFFING CHAOS!

FAM LAWYER MARC PROKOSCH 💼🛡️ spilling TEA ☕: 'They in SAN ANTONIO SLAMMER 🏰😩, but WE WON 🏆!' Meanwhile, TRUMP CREW 🍊👨‍💼💥 hyped MINNEAPOLIS FED FORCE SURGE 👮‍♂️🚀 but BACKPEDALED 🐌🔄 after SHOOTING OUTRAGE 😡🔫💀 of TWO US CITS – now JUDGE BLOCKED STATE'S PLEA 🙅‍♂️📜 to YEET the AGENTS! DHS GHOSTED BBC 👻📱, but Judge Biery said HOLD MY GAVEL 🔨: NO MORE BABY JAILS 🍼🚫! Liam's SPIDEY SENSE 🕷️🕸️ tinglin' for FREEDOM 🦅✨ – ICE CUCKED 🐔😩, toddler TRIUMPHS 🏅👶! Puns on point: This OP was a BUNNY HOP 😤🐰 straight to COURT CLAPBACK 👏💥! #FreeLiam #IceMelt 🧊🔥
